title: EventBridge Rules Stack Config
description: Schema for the eventbridge_stack config carrying an event_bridge_rules list. Each rule routes matched events on a bus to an SQS queue resolved from SSM at deploy time. Template variables (e.g., {{WORKLOAD_NAME}}, {{DEPLOYMENT_NAMESPACE}}) are supported in string fields.

event_bus_name.description: Target event bus name. Defaults to 'default'.

event_pattern.description: EventBridge event pattern (source / detail-type / detail filters).

target_queue_ssm_path.description: SSM parameter path resolving to the target queue ARN at deploy time.
